facts.name: Adrienne Fleming
facts.assignment: Civil non-dispositive hearings in Indian River, St. Lucie, Martin and Okeechobee counties.

contact.contact_note: Circuitwide civil magistrate office located in Port Saint Lucie; no Indian River chambers address or separate personal officer/assistant route inferred. Footer Suite217 is not adopted as individual office suite.

chambers_communications.summary: Email division account with case number/name/matter and purpose, all parties copied. Descriptive attachment names; same email thread, no duplicate messages. Telephone route for persons excused from email service; no text messages.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Practical section says all special-set hearings through assistant email, no online calendar, Indian River generally Wednesdays. File motion and attach timestamped copy; request duration for both sides, coordinate outside assistant thread, then obtain confirmation before notice. Additional-information section instead refers in-person scheduling online; discrepancy retained.

motions_and_conferral.summary: Non-dispositive matters only; no dispositive motion or matters moving e-docket/trial dates. Guide requires personal attorney/party conferral and good-faith notice certificate; staff scheduling alone insufficient. It states48business-week hours for response and conferral date within7days of filing. Rule1.202 stated exceptions retained; no independent exception analysis.

referral.summary: Procedures request proposed referral within3days of scheduling request; additional information says obtain referral before scheduling. Both preserved without selecting controlling sequence.

proposed_orders.summary: Word attachment, agreed/disagreed status in email, complete specific service list, searchable filename. One order accounts for all motions heard. Dedicated order section says2business days before hearing; hearing-material section includes proposed order within5business-day advance requirement.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email electronic materials to office/opposing party5business days before hearing, PDF preferred, highlights/tabs; paperless office.

remote_appearances.summary: Zoom unless in-person specially requested; ID5574784701, include credentials in notice. Video to testify. In-person scheduling route has conflicting online versus assistant-email instructions preserved.

exhibits.summary: File exhibit list with clerk; send list/exhibits to other party at least2business days before hearing. Clerk directs submission; for Zoom contact clerk at least2days before. Chambers receipt2days before; labeled copies for clerk/court/parties when in person.

cancellation.summary: Contact assistant, file and serve notice. Profile limits acceptance to withdrawn or rescheduled underlying pleading consistent with case-management order; no mere cancellation leaving matter unresolved.

accessibility.summary: Official ADA page referenced; identify interpreter needs to assistant/clerk for planning. Detailed shared access review remains at county stage.

facts.summary: Reused and re-reviewed civil magistrate operating evidence expressly applicable to Indian River; newer filtered roster confirms identity/contact route. Conflicting scheduling/referral/order timing and older Cox referral naming preserved.
